title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
quality_signal: W3C Recommendation with testable success criteria and combined automated/manual evaluation
limitations: Accessibility standard; not conversion or brand proof

title: How the Core Web Vitals metrics thresholds were defined
quality_signal: Method explains field metrics, thresholds, percentile classification, perception, and achievability
limitations: Performance thresholds do not determine message quality

title: Best practices for measuring Web Vitals in the field
quality_signal: Recommends real-user distributions and percentiles instead of averages
limitations: Requires a real traffic or RUM path; lab-only prototypes remain limited

title: Baymard UX Research Methodology
quality_signal: Large-scale moderated testing and manual benchmarking with explicit methods and limitations
limitations: Commerce-heavy and partly paywalled; transfer to service sites must be tested

title: Digital Subscription and SaaS UX Benchmark 2025
quality_signal: Public benchmark overview names sites and a large set of scored UX parameters
limitations: Full scores and examples require access; benchmark is not a conversion guarantee

title: B2B Usability
quality_signal: Original B2B user research with user testing and field studies
limitations: Published 2006; use as foundational context and re-test current assumptions

title: Awwwards Evaluation System
quality_signal: Publicly stated jury model and weights design 40%, usability 30%, creativity 20%, content 10%
limitations: Award signal; no independent conversion or field-performance proof

title: Prompy visual prompt gallery
quality_signal: Curated visual-prompt examples can supply vocabulary and hypotheses for controlled prompt experiments
limitations: Published terms state personal-use limits and prohibit copying or redistribution; gallery output is not quality, rights, accessibility, or conversion evidence

title: Webby Awards Judging Criteria
quality_signal: Explicit criteria include content, structure/navigation, visual design, functionality, interactivity, innovation, and overall experience
limitations: Jury rubric is not a user study or technical conformance audit

title: CSS Design Awards
quality_signal: Public UI, UX, and innovation judge scores expose a structured curation signal
limitations: Public scores are evaluative opinion, not task success or accessibility evidence

title: Siteinspire web design showcase
quality_signal: Large searchable visual collection useful for vocabulary and comparative references
limitations: No equivalent normative or research methodology; inspiration only

title: Whip Around B2B SaaS case study
quality_signal: Describes interviews, analytics/heatmaps, information architecture, and a live trial/demo path
limitations: Agency-authored case study; claims and metrics require independent verification

title: NextLevel business advisory positioning case study
quality_signal: Shows positioning and service-firm messaging work tied to an inspectable project narrative
limitations: Client outcome and method depth must be verified before pattern promotion

title: Uncommon Studio creative studio case study
quality_signal: Documents a shipped creative studio site and the implementation choices behind it
limitations: Award mention is not conversion proof; inspect rights, performance, and mobile path

title: Trust Company regulated website case study
quality_signal: Connects accessibility-first implementation, performance, and regulated-service constraints
limitations: Vendor case study; independent audit and user evidence are still required

title: Public design critique forum discovery thread
quality_signal: Shows where public critique communities are found and distinguishes critique from inspiration
limitations: Directory answers do not establish quality; use only to recruit critique and record dissent
